question_text: A foreign investor wants to acquire a 5-hectare residential lot in Tagaytay. Under Article XII of the 1987 Philippine Constitution, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: The foreign investor may acquire the lot because the Constitution allows foreign ownership of land for residential use up to 10 hectares.
The foreign investor may acquire the lot only if he invests at least USD 200,000 in the country.
The foreign investor cannot acquire the lot because the Constitution generally prohibits aliens from owning land in the Philippines.
The foreign investor may acquire the lot if he becomes a naturalized citizen within five years.
